title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text: 5. Welcomes the strong momentum in EU-Armenia relations and Armenia’s continued commitment to democracy, the rule of law, human rights and ambitious political and economic reforms; stresses that economic cooperation must be accompanied by strong social and environmental safeguards, including the protection of workers’ rights and public services and compliance with climate objectives, in order to ensure that economic development benefits the entire population;
